name: Incomer-bus-tie interlock matrix
summary: Checks the assigned incomer and tie combinations against the permitted switchboard configurations.
description: Checks the assigned incomer and tie combinations against the permitted switchboard configurations. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Incomer and tie positions” at the input and “Allowed switching combination” at the output. The permitted combinations must be documented explicitly.
